title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Upendra Kamat
   

  

**Description**
**ParentPay Group** 
 is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs.
   

  

 PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market\-leading SIMS software solution
   

  

 SIMS is at the heart of 19,000 schools, including over 700 independent and international schools in 49 countries.
   

  

**What We Are Doing**
 We are developing a new single authentication solution that will be integrated and used by all products within the ParentPay Group.
   

  

 A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met.
   

  

 The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience. You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop understanding of the Domain and technical intricacies of the product.
* Consistently evaluate and become the expert in the domain space.
* Collaborate with the product stakeholders to understand the Acceptance criteria thoroughly.
* Build robust UI/UX solution using .NET, C\#, Microservices, HTML, CSS technologies.
* Would need to work on Azure B2C implementation.
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Understanding of oauth api call sequence
* Strong Agile Development Practices
* Ability to work in a technical environment. Should have experience with Whitebox testing techniques.
* Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills**
* .NET 8 or later
* Azure ecosystem (ADO)
* C\#
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Strong understanding of API Design
* Agile Development Practices


**Desired Skills**
* k8s
* kiuwan or similar for security testing
* JUnit or similar for unit testing

description:
**About Vcheck**
 We started in 2012, in an era when due diligence was still largely manual, opaque, and inconsistent. Financial institutions needed reliable intelligence but faced a frustrating choice: slow, expensive boutique firms or fast, superficial automated checks. We saw an opportunity to bring the investigative rigor of boutique firms to scale through technology.
   

  

 From our early days conducting background checks for commercial real estate lenders and private equity deals to building a best\-in\-class portfolio monitoring platform and what is arguably the industry's most advanced investigations platform, our vision remains unchanged: help businesses see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence.
   

  

****Where We Are Today****
* Based in New York City with global operations spanning the US, Romania, India, and soon\-to\-be London
* 25,000\+ investigations annually across six continents
* Five consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies
* Backed by Sunstone Partners, a leading private equity firm supporting our next phase of growth
* Trusted by top\-tier financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies


 Vcheck has a talented and collaborative team. While many of our team members come from backgrounds in compliance, law enforcement, journalism, or intelligence, many others have built successful careers here without prior investigative experience. What unites us is intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
   

  

 We're building something different: a comprehensive portfolio risk management platform that operates with the rigor of a top\-tier investigative shop and the efficiency of a modern technology company. If you're excited about that combination and ready to build learning programs that scale operational excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help lead Vcheck's transition from a traditional, service\-based model to an innovative, high\-growth digital platform. This is a foundational role where you won't just maintain features — you'll be instrumental in defining and building the future of Vcheck. You will own the end\-to\-end design lifecycle for key areas of our platform, combining exceptional design craft with deep strategic UX thinking and the ability to articulate complex concepts through clear, compelling design and high\-impact presentations. We're looking for someone who thrives on complexity, communicates with clarity and confidence, and is ready to be the design voice leading a major business transformation.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Drive design strategy and execution for core platform features, translating complex financial workflows and data into simple, intuitive user experiences
* Deliver production\-ready designs with an uncompromising standard for visual quality, aesthetic judgment, and attention to detail
* Evolve and govern our platform\-wide Design System, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and efficiency across all products
* Plan and conduct user research (interviews, usability testing) and data analysis to inform design decisions and uncover unmet user needs
* Produce comprehensive design documentation, including user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and specifications for engineering teams
* Act as the primary design partner for Product Managers, Engineering leads, and internal stakeholders, fostering seamless cross\-department collaboration
* Confidently present and defend design solutions, strategy, and rationale to executive leadership, articulating how design decisions directly impact business outcomes and user success
* Facilitate design reviews and workshops, soliciting and synthesizing feedback from diverse teams and translating it into actionable design iterations


**About You**
****Key requirements:****
 We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
   

  

* 5\-7 years of experience designing and shipping successful digital products, with significant experience in complex B2B platforms, enterprise software, or financial technology
* Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* An exceptional portfolio demonstrating mastery of visual design, information hierarchy, and interaction design (micro\-interactions, states, animations)
* Demonstrated ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively across written, verbal, and visual mediums
* Comfortable leading large, diverse groups through design reviews and presentations
* Experience working in an Agile environment, collaborating directly with front\-end engineers to ensure design integrity during implementation
* Expert proficiency in Figma or equivalent design and prototyping tools


****Why us?****
 You Will Be Joining a Cutting\-edge Company, Where You Will Tackle Complex Challenges And Work With The Very Best In The Industry. In Addition, We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits, including GHI coverage for you \& your loved ones
* Flexible vacation policy, encouraging you to take the time you need
* Comfortable shift(s) to maintain work life balance

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a Video Analytics Engineer with 3\-5 years of hands\-on experience to build, improve, and optimize computer vision and video processing solutions that convert raw video streams into actionable intelligence. This role is ideal for an engineer who is strong in implementation and deployment, while also being curious about model behavior, failure analysis, and practical experimentation to improve accuracy in real\-world scenarios.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of deep learning, real\-time video processing, and scalable backend systems, contributing to use cases across security, retail, traffic, and industrial environments. You will partner with senior engineers and research\-oriented team members to adapt existing approaches, evaluate results, and help move promising ideas into reliable production systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end video analytics pipelines covering ingestion, decoding, preprocessing, inference, and post\-processing.
* Build, fine\-tune, test, and deploy computer vision models for object detection, tracking, classification, action recognition, and anomaly detection.
* Analyze model outputs, identify common failure cases, and support experiments to improve robustness under occlusion, crowd density, lighting variation, and camera diversity.
* Optimize inference performance on edge and cloud GPUs using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or similar runtimes.
* Implement real\-time video processing using GStreamer, FFmpeg, or DeepStream, with low\-latency streaming over RTSP, WebRTC, or HLS.
* Support dataset curation, annotation review, data augmentation, and retraining workflows to improve model quality over time.
* Collaborate with product, QA, and senior technical teams to translate business requirements into deployable analytics features.
* Contribute to benchmarking, validation, and performance measurement using clear metrics for accuracy, latency, and throughput.
* Engineer backend services and supporting utilities for multi\-camera orchestration, metadata handling, and monitoring.
* Maintain documentation, write unit and integration tests, and follow CI/CD best practices for model and service releases.
